_comment: Consent wording baseline. Each sha is the first 16 hex of sha256 over the normalised `text` in apps/web/lib/floor-graph/consent.ts. Editing a wording without bumping its version fails scripts/verify-floor-graph.mjs, because the consent ledger stores the exact string that was shown to the person. Regenerate the values with `node scripts/verify-floor-graph.mjs --update`.
